name: Impression of Will
body:
You can embed specific instructions into your telepathic contact.

Prerequisite(s): Drawn to awe spell-like ability, character level 5

Benefit(s): Whenever you use drawn to awe, a telepathic description of a single course of action, described in no more than 15 words, is carried across by your aura to all creatures inside it as part of the action. The description is automatically understood by them, within the limits of their mental ability scores. They are under no obligation to follow the suggestion, but those who do remain Helpful towards you for the purposes of this task until it is complete, you cause them harm, or the duration expires.
